biggest_catch: The $95 annual fee comes out of the bonus: 60,000 ThankYou points (redeemable for $600 in gift cards at thankyou.com) minus the $95 fee leaves $505 of first-year net value, and only if you hit $4,000 in 3 months with spending you already planned.
catches: Claim the bonus only with spending you already planned; never buy things you don't need just to hit the $4,000 target.
The $95 annual fee reduces the bonus — first-year net math is in the biggest catch above.
Applying for the card causes a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily lower your credit score.
The variable purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance for even a month or two wipes out the bonus value — pay the statement balance in full every month.

Bonus points are not available if you received a new account bonus for a Citi Premier or Citi Strata Premier account in the past 48 months, or converted another Citi card on which you earned a bonus in the last 48 months into one (Citi's 48-month family rule).
Bonus points may take one to two additional billing cycles to post to your ThankYou account — keep the account open until they land.

steps: Go to the official Citi Strata Premier page and read the bonus terms (60,000 points after $4,000 in the first 3 months; $95 annual fee).
Confirm you have not received a Citi Premier or Citi Strata Premier new-account bonus in the past 48 months (and have not converted a bonus-earning Citi card into one in the last 48 months).
Apply online through the official Citi page and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Within the first 3 months of account opening, put $4,000 of already-planned purchases on the card — never extra spending for the bonus.
Pay the statement balance in full every month — carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR destroys the bonus math.
Keep the account open and check thankyou.com — the 60,000 bonus points may take one to two additional billing cycles to post; redeem for $600 in gift cards or compare travel redemptions.
timing: Bonus points may take one to two additional billing cycles to post to your ThankYou account after you meet the $4,000-in-3-months requirement.
